name: Recruiting Factory
summary: One agent that screens every applicant and referral against a structured role rubric, drafts interview kits and candidate updates, and keeps your ATS pipeline clean. A person decides every step.

secrets.name: RECRUITING_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.why: Signs the webhook your careers form, your referral form or an ATS relay calls for a new application or referral (Authorization: Bearer).

secrets.name: ASHBY_API_KEY
secrets.why: System of record Ashby, when the workspace has no Ashby connector. Read candidates and applications, write notes.

secrets.name: GREENHOUSE_API_KEY
secrets.why: System of record Greenhouse (Harvest API), with GREENHOUSE_USER_ID, when the workspace has no Greenhouse connector. Read candidates and applications, write private notes.

secrets.name: GREENHOUSE_USER_ID
secrets.why: System of record Greenhouse: the id of the Greenhouse user every note is written on behalf of (On-Behalf-Of). Not a secret.

secrets.name: LEVER_API_KEY
secrets.why: System of record Lever, when the workspace has no Lever connector. Read opportunities, write notes.

secrets.name: WORKABLE_API_TOKEN
secrets.why: System of record Workable, with WORKABLE_SUBDOMAIN, when the workspace has no Workable connector. Read candidates and jobs, write comments.

secrets.name: WORKABLE_SUBDOMAIN
secrets.why: System of record Workable: your account subdomain, for example example in example.workable.com. Not a secret.

secrets.name: GH_TOKEN
secrets.why: System of record json-file only: read and write the ledger branch of a private repository with gh.
